spans.label: Imported plonky2, keccak gadget and recursive-verification helpers
spans.note: `use` lines pull in plonky2 builder/proof APIs, the Poseidon and keccak gadgets and the typed limb traits. The model treats all of them as opaque callbacks or premises; no lowering is proved.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputs fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the seven public-input fields (initial/final block number, block hash chain, extended commitment, and prover) are modeled structurally.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputs::from_states
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the span endpoints are read out of the two extended states and every other extended-state field reaches the public inputs only through the Poseidon commitment.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputs::to_u32_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the 2 + 8 + 8 + 2 + 8 + 8 + 5 = 41 u32-limb concatenation order is modeled, and the big-endian recomposition of those limbs is checked against contracts/test/data/vpi_fixture.json.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputs::hash (solidity_keccak256)
spans.note: keccak itself is an opaque callback; what IS modeled is the byte serialization solidity_keccak256 applies (each u32 as four big-endian bytes). On that serialization the circuit's 164-byte preimage is DERIVED equal to RollupValue.hashPreimage (.validityPis ...), the preimage IntmaxRollup.finalize hashes.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputsTarget fields
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the target carries the same seven fields in the same order.

spans.label: Target allocation and witness assignment
spans.note: BlockNumberTarget/Bytes32Target/AddressTarget allocation with is_checked, and PartialWitness assignment, are plonky2 boundaries.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputsTarget::to_vec
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the in-circuit limb order is the same 41-word list as the native to_u32_vec.

spans.label: ValidityPublicInputsTarget::hash (builder.keccak256)
spans.note: The in-circuit keccak gadget is opaque; agreement between it and the native solidity_keccak256 on the same preimage is a named premise.

spans.label: ValidityCircuitError variants
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; the prove and verify failure kinds are modeled by the shared Fault type.

spans.label: Circuit handle, proof targets and dummy proof
spans.note: CircuitData, ProofWithPublicInputsTarget and the DummyProof are opaque plonky2 objects; only the public-input list a proof carries is modeled. The extensive source prose about the aggregate-list wrapper's verifier key is NOT promoted to a guarantee.

spans.label: Comment, attribute or whitespace
spans.note: Read-only source commentary, derive/where attribute or closing brace; prose is not promoted to an executable guarantee.

spans.label: ValidityCircuit::new constraint system
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics of the gate set: cyclic verification of the block-hash-chain proof with the constant verifier data connected to the one the proof re-exports; should_verify_list computed from the FOLDED final.bp_sig_chain rather than a prover flag; conditional aggregate-list verification plus commitment equality; and registration of the keccak of the validity public inputs built from the SAME parsed states. Also recorded as satisfiable-but-unconstrained: a non-zero initial bp_sig_chain, and any ordering of the initial and final block numbers. Recursive verification remains an opaque predicate.

spans.label: Comment, attribute or whitespace
spans.note: Read-only source commentary, derive/where attribute or closing brace; prose is not promoted to an executable guarantee.

spans.label: ValidityCircuit::prove
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; passing None silently substitutes the dummy aggregate-list proof, and with the dummy's all-zero commitment the constraint system is unsatisfiable whenever the folded chain is non-empty. Proving itself is not modeled.

spans.label: ValidityCircuit::verify
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; unlike BlockHashChainCircuit::verify this path runs no native cyclic verifier-data check. The corresponding binding is the in-circuit verifier-data equality in Gates.

spans.label: #[cfg(test)] mod tests
spans.note: Test module. The 2^16 validity degree and 2^14 aggregate-list wrapper degree assertions are recorded in the model as constants only; nothing derives them, and the test's end-to-end public-input equality is not reproduced.

boundaries.name: recursive_proof_verification
boundaries.obligation: add_proof_target_and_verify_cyclic and add_proof_target_and_conditionally_verify are opaque predicates. No proof soundness, no knowledge extraction, and in particular nothing that says a verified aggregate-list proof really witnesses N-of-N Falcon signatures.

boundaries.name: keccak_preimage_coherence
boundaries.obligation: That the circuit's keccak (native solidity_keccak256 and the in-circuit gadget alike) is the same function IntmaxRollup's keccak256 computes over the same preimage is the explicit premise RollupValue.HashEncodingAgrees. The byte layout of the two preimages IS derived equal; the hash itself is not.

boundaries.name: poseidon_commitment
boundaries.obligation: ExtendedPublicState commitments are opaque Poseidon outputs. Deposit chain, registration chain, deposit count, bp_sig_chain and every tree root reach the contract only through them, so binding those fields depends on an undischarged collision-resistance assumption.

boundaries.name: agg_list_verifier_key
boundaries.obligation: The source notes that the aggregate-list and the retired single-signature list wrappers present identical CommonCircuitData, so only the baked-in verifier key separates them. Which key is actually baked in, and what statement each folded step proves, is outside this model.

boundaries.name: block_number_and_chain_monotonicity
boundaries.obligation: This circuit imposes no order between the initial and final block numbers and no relation between the two extended states beyond what the folded block-chain proof asserts. Monotonicity and chain continuity must come from block_step / update_channel_tree and from IntmaxRollup.fullVerify's blockHashAt comparisons.

boundaries.name: native_target_refinement
boundaries.obligation: No proof relates the handwritten model to the Rust source, to the plonky2 gate lowering, or to the MLE wrapper that actually carries this circuit's public inputs on chain.
